prompt:
Use your built-in image generation tool to create 13 separate square PNG icons that form ONE consistent set for a figure in a scientific paper. Make one image_gen call per icon.
Style for every icon: clean flat vector illustration, uniform thin dark-grey outlines, soft pastel fills with the accent colour as the main hue, at most one lighter tint for highlights, no gradients, no drop shadows, no texture.
Pure white (#FFFFFF) background, square 1024x1024 canvas, the subject centred with about 12% empty margin on every side. It will be printed 6-9 mm wide, so use bold outlines (about 2.5% of the canvas width), large simple shapes and few small details; it must stay clear at 64x64 px. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, UI chrome, borders or frames anywhere in the image.
Image 1 (f_c1.png) is a STYLE REFERENCE from the same figure set, not an edit target: match its character design, outline weight, fill treatment and margin.
Icons:
(1) aware.png: an open eye with two small radar arcs beside it, meaning continuous awareness of the situation, accent colour #2E8B57.
(2) anticipate.png: a small line chart whose solid line continues as a dotted forecast line into the future, meaning anticipation, accent colour #2F6FC0.
(3) agenda.png: a clipboard with three checkbox lines (blank bars, no words), meaning an agenda of goals, accent colour #7A54C2.
(4) arbitrate.png: a simple balance scale with two pans, meaning deciding whether to act, accent colour #E08A1E.
(5) act.png: a round play button with a small spark at its edge, meaning taking action, accent colour #D9583B.
(6) adapt.png: two circular arrows chasing each other around a small gear, meaning learning and adaptation, accent colour #1F8A8C.
(7) era_control.png: a vintage control panel with two round analogue gauges and a lever, accent colour #1F8A8C.
(8) era_planning.png: an old boxy CRT computer whose screen shows a small tree diagram of connected nodes, accent colour #2F6FC0.
(9) era_bdi.png: three small connected circles in a triangle, containing a simple eye, a heart and a flag as symbols (belief, desire, intention), no letters, accent colour #7A54C2.
(10) era_ubiquitous.png: a smartphone showing a map pin, with wifi waves above it, accent colour #2E8B57.
(11) era_mixed.png: two overlapping chat bubbles, one containing a small check mark, no text, accent colour #E08A1E.
(12) era_goals.png: an open notebook with three checkbox bars and a small star rising above it, accent colour #7A54C2.
(13) era_foundation.png: a stack of three rounded layers forming a model block, with a wrench, a globe and a document icon orbiting it, accent colour #5B6577.
Copy each final image into the current directory with exactly those file names, overwrite nothing else, do not edit the images afterwards, then list the directory.
